svg.title: One order, two downstream identities
svg.desc: Orders calls Inventory with delegated user identity and Notifications with its own service identity.
svg.text: Each API validates its own audience and permissions.
Any of the three UI alternatives
Validate the incoming user access token · audience: orders-api
POST /orders requires the manager realm role
Orders makes both downstream calls. Each token is scoped to its target API.
User delegation and workload identity are separate authorization decisions.
